author: AtditC
body:
Hello Avicus Staff members!

Another report of a team griefer...

Name of Player being reported: MontyPylon81
Rule broken: Stealing Multiple Iron Armors/Breaking Chests full of Iron Armor Sets > Team Griefing
Evidence: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G_jxkLSIlT8
Anything else you would like to add? Sorry for the caps I used... I'm getting mad when somebody steals my iron >:)

Let's have an Avicus server without team griefers! From now, each one seen from me, will pay for what he has done!

Greetings,
Atdit
